semantic_search.name: semantic_search
semantic_search.title: Semantic Search
semantic_search.description:
Analytical search. Return structured JSON; signals via rerank or fields. Agentic workflows: analytics, reports, downstream processing.

Examples: tea-rags://schema/search-guide
Param docs: tea-rags://schema/overview. This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

project.description: Alias from list_projects/prime; pass every call.

path.description: Your working tree (cwd / worktree); pass WITH project.

scope.description: Default code. Use migrations for Rails schema history (not current state); ranks by relevance and ignores signal rerank presets.

query.description: Query text, or up to 5 variants (array or 'a ||| b') fused in one call.

filter.description: Raw Qdrant filter (must/should/must_not) or { presets: "a,b" }. Omitted → preset default filter; {} clears. tea-rags://schema/overview. Presets: production, coreLogic, securityPaths, freshLegacyEdits, fragileSilo, panicZone, godMethods, hubs, deadCandidates, unstableCore, battleTested, abandonedHotspots.

chunkType.description: Filter by chunk type (function, class, interface, block)

documentation.description: Doc chunks: only | exclude | include. Omitted → preset default may exclude docs; only/include drops it.

testFile.description: Test files: only | exclude | include. Omitted → preset default may exclude tests; only/include drops it.

author.description: Blame owner (most live lines, git blame HEAD), exact name. File default; level 'chunk' → chunk lines.

recentAuthor.description: Top committer to the FILE in git log window (not blame), exact name or email. 'What X worked on'.

contributor.description: Any committer to the FILE in git log window, exact name (no email); superset of recentAuthor.

modifiedAfter.description: File last commit on/after ISO date ('2024-01-01'). File-level at any level.

modifiedBefore.description: File last commit on/before ISO date ('2024-12-31'). File-level at any level.

minAgeDays.description: Last commit ≥ N days old, query time. Chunk default drops docs + no-commit chunks; level 'file' → file.

maxAgeDays.description: Last commit ≤ N whole days old, query time (0 = within a day). Level-aware like minAgeDays.

minCommitCount.description: Min commits touching the chunk (churn). Level-aware, chunk default.

taskId.description: Task ID from commit messages (TD-1234, #567, AB#890). File default; level 'chunk' → chunk commits.

symbolId.description: Partial symbolId text match: 'Class' hits all its methods, 'method' hits it in any class.

minFanIn.description: Min fan-in. File default = files importing this file; level 'chunk' = call sites.

minFanOut.description: Min fan-out. File default = files this file imports; level 'chunk' = outgoing calls.

minPageRank.description: Min chunk-level PageRank in [0,1] over the method call graph.

minInstability.description: Min Martin instability fanOut / (fanIn + fanOut), in [0,1]. File-level only.

minTransitiveImpact.description: Min distinct files transitively importing this file (depth-capped reverse BFS). File-level only.

minConnectionCount.description: Min file-graph edges (fanIn + fanOut); drops low-confidence instability values. File-level only.

isHub.description: Files flagged architectural hubs (fanIn above collection p95). File-level only.

isLeaf.description: Files flagged leaves (fanOut == 0, fanIn > 0). File-level only.

level.description: 'chunk' ranks chunks; 'file' ranks files, file payload only, no content. Also scopes level-aware filters. Default: preset signalLevel.

rerank.description: Preset, or {custom: {<signal>: number}}; signals: tea-rags://guide/signals, presets: tea-rags://guide/presets.

fields.description: Payload dot-path allow-list, e.g. ['relativePath', 'git.file.commitCount']. EXACT: nothing added back. Omitted → [relativePath,symbolId,startLine,endLine,content]; metaOnly → [relativePath,symbolId,startLine,endLine,signature]. Paths: tea-rags://schema/signals.

includeImports.description: imports = count by default; true → full lists. Import edges exact: get_callees / get_callers(relativePath).

metaOnly.description: Drop content. Payload = locator (path, symbolId, lines, signature); labels in rankingOverlay; raw signals via fields. Contract: tea-rags://schema/overview. Default: false.

banner.description: First key when present: next-step imperative — follow it.

anyOf.description: One row per result; cell i belongs to columns[i]. Dotted column = payload path (payload.relativePath, rankingOverlay.chunk.bugFixRate.label). null = absent; a column null in every row is omitted. Columns: [id, score], payload.* (raw values; content omitted when metaOnly), rankingOverlay.{file,chunk}.* (labels), treeState (modified|deleted: index copy of a file your tree changed, may be stale).

id.description: Chunk ID (search tools: only with fields)

score.description: Relevance score (search tools: only with fields)

payload.description: Chunk payload: relativePath, startLine, endLine, language, chunkType, symbolId, name, content (omitted when metaOnly=true), trajectory signals under git.{file,chunk}.* / codegraph.*, plus find_symbol's chunkCount / mergedChunkIds. Raw values only — labels live on rankingOverlay. imports = count unless includeImports=true; floats at 2 significant digits.

file.description: File-level signals keyed by bare field name: {value,label} when labelled, else the raw value

chunk.description: Chunk-level signals keyed by bare field name: {value,label} when labelled, else the raw value

treeState.description: Index row of a file your working tree changed or deleted; content may be stale

results.description: Two or more results: the table. Zero or one: a plain list of result records.

level.description: Effective signal level used for scoring

confidence.description: Match quality, collection-relative. low = query likely has no match in project. Advisory — never filters results. semantic_search / find_similar only; absent on hybrid_search, rank_chunks, find_symbol, and on indexes with no measured scale (reindex fills it).

value.description: 0-1: score magnitude vs this collection's own similarity scale + path clustering

fieldsWarning.description: A path you passed in `fields` matched NO result, so its payloads came back without it. Names the path and, where the returned payloads carry the same leaf elsewhere, the paths that would have matched (e.g. git.commitCount → git.file.commitCount). Also legitimate when the index simply lacks that enrichment.

presetFilterNotice.description: A rerank preset's DEFAULT filter narrowed this result set and you did not write it. Most presets default to production (no tests / docs / block chunks), so a thin or empty answer may be the default, not the corpus. Re-run with the named clearWith param to see the excluded population. Absent whenever you passed your own 'filter'.

preset.description: Rerank preset whose DEFAULT filter applied

by.description: Filter-preset name(s) and the payload keys they constrain, e.g. 'coreLogic (chunkType, isTest, codegraph.symbols.file.skippedAs)'

clearWith.description: Search param that clears the default — always 'filter: {}'

excluded.description: Candidates the default removed, when the count was free

workingTree.description: Tree read vs index commit. project = registry alias of the answering index (pass it as project next call); absent (call had project + path = tree) or tree + project only = every row current; changedFiles / deletedFiles appear only beside a field below (rows without treeState are current); degraded = run remedy; indexOnlyFiles = changed non-code files whose rows are the index's (treeState); pendingFiles = changed code files still warming, answered from the index this call (treeState); unparsed = changed files the tree's rows lack; treeGraphUnavailable = why graph signals are the index's; denseUnavailable = why some tree rows ranked without vectors (absent from dense ranking); gitUnavailable = how many changed-file rows still lack git signals (computing; re-call later).

denseUnavailable.description: hybrid_search only: embedding provider down, so results are ranked by BM25 alone (exact names still match; no semantic ranking). reason = the provider's error.

codegraphWarning.description: Optional codegraph lookup skipped — codegraph unreachable from this server (stale daemon build, build skew, daemon down, lock held). Names error code + remedy; results may miss collapsed symbols. Surface to user.

empty.description: Empty results only — why + ≤5 alternatives. hybrid_search / semantic_search: pathPatternMatchesNothing (suggestions = nearest existing prefix), filteredOut (what to drop, filter: {}), noMatch. find_symbol: unknownSymbol (single symbol; suggestions = the real id: other #/. separator, #partN parent, same short name; batch misses stay in missing[]), ambiguous (partial path, several ids = suggestions), unknownPath (suggestions = nearest paths), noSymbols (no symbol chunks: default code read tool). Act on it; empty with reason ≠ grep needed.

missing.description: find_symbol symbols only: addresses nothing answered; ambiguous → qualify with Class# or pathPattern; unknown path → suggestions = nearest paths.

batchNotice.description: find_symbol symbols: a path outlined, not read, or a dir refused.

directory.description: find_symbol directory path: results = its files (relativePath, language, symbols); subdirs one level down.

truncated.description: Over the response budget: tail rows dropped whole. next = same call for the rest — run verbatim.

find_symbol.name: find_symbol
find_symbol.title: Find Symbol
find_symbol.description:
Find symbol by name or file outline by relativePath — direct lookup, no embedding. symbol mode: function/method → merged full body; class/module → member OUTLINE (method ids, no method bodies, tests excluded) + header chunks (consts, DSL, fields) listed by lines, inlined whole up to 6000 chars per class, 24000 per answer shared with file text, which takes priority (kind:'containerHeader'; rest: 'not inlined', their member ids answer them); doc:<hash> → full section content. relativePath mode: small code file (≤150 lines, or outline ≥ file) → full text, kind:'file', lines 1..endLine; else file-level outline (code symbols); doc → TOC with doc:<hash> ids; metaOnly → outline; directory path → files + top-level symbols + subdirs (`directory`); unknown path → `empty.suggestions`. symbols mode: 1-20 symbol ids / file paths (file → as relativePath, full text until the batch's 24000-char budget, then outline; dir → missing), rows keyed by `request`, misses in `missing` (unknown path → `suggestions`), a chunk another row carries → `sameChunkAs`, lean payload unless fields/rerank. Outline/TOC lines are addresses — read one member/section via find_symbol(symbol: '<id from line>'), never Read the file or grep a saved dump. Member lines may end in declared visibility, e.g. 'Class#helper (private)' (codegraph; no suffix = unknown) — drop the suffix before drilling. Uses Qdrant text match. Partial match supported: 'Reranker' → class outline; 'B::C' → 'A::B::C'. symbolId convention: Class#method (instance), Class.method (static). Single-call diagnostic: pass `rerank` preset (e.g. "hotspots") to attach rankingOverlay with churn/ownership/bugFixRate labels alongside definition — no second semantic_search needed.

Param docs: tea-rags://schema/overview. This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

find_co_changed.name: find_co_changed
find_co_changed.title: Find Co-Changed Files
find_co_changed.description: File co-change partners from git history (cg_temporal sub-graph). Ranked by Wilson lower-bound strength; each partner carries support, both directed confidences (pPartnerGivenFile, pFileGivenPartner), lift, sample commits, structurallyLinked — an import/method/barrel edge joins the pair, false = silent coupling. Provenance echoes head, window and build cuts; partners deleted from the working tree are dropped. built:false = no co-change build yet (run a codegraph enrichment), NEVER read it as 'no partners'; carries empty {reason:notBuilt}. files[].empty {reason:noHistory} = file shares no commit in window. Before editing a file, surface silent high-strength partners as change-context. This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

find_cycles.name: find_cycles
find_cycles.title: Find Cycles
find_cycles.description: Return strongly-connected components (cycles) from import or call graph. Cycles length >= 2; single-node 'cycles' excluded. Read from pre-computed table — sub-millisecond per call. scope=method: members are symbol ids and memberLocations lists {symbolId, relativePath} per member in the same order — namesakes in different files are distinct members; an empty relativePath means the cycle was not recomputed since the index upgrade. hasModelEdge:true + modelEdgeCount = hops inside the cycle only residual-model edges support (absent = all static). notices[] = answer stands but is a lower bound (Rust edges static-only: rustc driver did not index). This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

get_callees.name: get_callees
get_callees.title: Get Callees
get_callees.description: Return symbols invoked by given symbolId. Backed by codegraph DuckDB. Host-class id with no node of its own (Account.suspended, member defined in an included module or superclass) → answered via first definer up hierarchy in MRO order; resolvedSymbolId names the id queried. Class/module id → also its direct members' edges: row member = member reached (#run, .call), one row per caller+member (callee: member+target); memberRollup {members, internalCallers|internalCallees} counts edges between its own members, not listed. Each callee carries the target's declared visibility (private|protected|public; absent = unknown). Calls whose target symbol the resolver could not pin are not rows: unresolved = their count, unresolvedCalls = up to 5 distinct call expressions. One row per target symbol; count = call sites folded in. Entries with origin:'model' come from residual resolution: probabilistic (carry model, p), not compiler truth. File scope: pass relativePath instead of symbolId → {relativePath, imports[], total} — files it imports, each {relativePath, importText, callWeight, modelCallWeight?, origin?}, heaviest callWeight first; origin:'model' = only a model call links them; unknown file → empty imports + message. depth 2–3 → BFS tree rows (parent = row the edge leaves; seen = listed earlier, not re-expanded; external = unresolved sites); a cut page's truncated.next = next page, run as given. Wrong separator (Foo.bar for instance member), or the queried form has no edges and the other has → other form answered, named in resolvedSymbolId. Empty answer carries empty {reason, message, suggestions?}: unknownSymbol (no node; suggestions = ids with same short name), testChunk (id is an indexed test chunk; tests are not graph nodes), noEdges (node, no edges; message flags lower bound when language resolve rate < 0.9), unknownFile, treeOnly (only in your tree, its graph not ready: find_symbol). treeGraphUnavailable → rows whose file your tree changed carry treeState; queriedTreeState = the queried one's. notices[] = answer stands but is a lower bound (Rust edges static-only: rustc driver did not index). This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

get_architecture_report.name: get_architecture_report
get_architecture_report.title: Get Architecture Report
get_architecture_report.description: Architecture diagnostics: is code laid out correctly (NOT is it risky to touch — use risk-assessment). Typed violations per detector, one table each, tiered then costliest-first; evidence cut to evidenceLimit, drillDown = ready follow-up call. Modes, one per call: report (default; options layerMap, norms, domain = judge a directory AS ITS OWN SYSTEM) | knotOf | plannedEdges = judge edges before writing | restructure = what-if delta | restructurePlan = ordered plan. Page via reportId + limit/offset. Read tea-rags://guide/architecture to interpret the answer. This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

project.description: Alias from list_projects/prime; pass every call.

path.description: Your working tree (cwd / worktree); pass WITH project.

pathPattern.description: Glob scoping judged edges by SOURCE file. Instability, adoption and layer levels stay whole-graph. Omit for whole project.

domain.description: Directory root judged AS ITS OWN SYSTEM: induced sub-graph, every metric recomputed inside; response.domain carries border edges with whole-graph levels.

norms.description: Role-pair norms: response.norms + violations for edges against their role pair's established direction (MISFIT).

changeReasons.description: response.changeReasons: per component, distinct domains of tickets that changed it; ticket domain = dominant OTHER component touched.

limit.description: Max violations and max root causes per detector (default 50). Summary keeps totals.

layerMap.description: Also return the layer map VIEW: levels per node in scopePathPattern, boundary edges with global levels, move candidates.

knotOf.description: Component path from drillDown: return its knot view and the findings inside it, paged by limit/offset

offset.description: Violations skipped per detector, after ranking; with reportId pages one judgement. Knot mode: pages the knotOf view.

reportId.description: Previous answer's reportId: page it without recompute. MCP server memory only (CLI call recomputes); re-editing changed files undetected until TTL.

evidenceLimit.description: Max entries per evidence list, summary included (default 3); "all" = untrimmed. Trimmed part -> next call restores it.

detectors.description: Return only these detectors' violation groups, root causes and summary blocks; graph-wide blocks stay.

plannedEdges.description: File pairs source->target about to be written: verdicts only, no report; other options rejected. reference = name used.

restructure.description: One what-if hypothesis: violation delta vs current partition, no report; only limit may ride along.

restructurePlan.description: Order candidate hypotheses greedily; ids unique, not report:-prefixed; report split/merge added unless false.

get_callers.name: get_callers
get_callers.title: Get Callers
get_callers.description: Return symbols that invoke given symbolId. Backed by codegraph DuckDB. Host-class id with no node of its own (Account.suspended, member defined in an included module or superclass) → answered via first definer up hierarchy in MRO order; resolvedSymbolId names the id queried. Class/module id → also its direct members' edges: row member = member reached (#run, .call), one row per caller+member (callee: member+target); memberRollup {members, internalCallers|internalCallees} counts edges between its own members, not listed. Top-level visibility = queried symbol's declared level; each caller carries its own (private|protected|public; absent = unknown). Pass includeAmbiguous:true to also list ambiguous dispatch sites (member-matched, MAY reach target among candidateCount candidates; not materialized as edges). Entries with origin:'model' come from residual resolution: probabilistic (carry model, p), not compiler truth. File scope: pass relativePath instead of symbolId → {relativePath, importers[], total} — files that import it, each {relativePath, importText, callWeight, modelCallWeight?, origin?}, heaviest callWeight first; origin:'model' = only a model call links them; unknown file → empty importers + message. depth 2–3 → BFS tree rows (parent = row the edge leaves; seen = listed earlier, not re-expanded; external = unresolved sites); a cut page's truncated.next = next page, run as given. Wrong separator (Foo.bar for instance member), or the queried form has no edges and the other has → other form answered, named in resolvedSymbolId. Empty answer carries empty {reason, message, suggestions?}: unknownSymbol (no node; suggestions = ids with same short name), testChunk (id is an indexed test chunk; tests are not graph nodes), noEdges (node, no edges; message flags lower bound when language resolve rate < 0.9), unknownFile, treeOnly (only in your tree, its graph not ready: find_symbol). treeGraphUnavailable → rows whose file your tree changed carry treeState; queriedTreeState = the queried one's. notices[] = answer stands but is a lower bound (Rust edges static-only: rustc driver did not index). This tool is part of plugin `tea-rags`.

project.description: Alias from list_projects/prime; pass every call.

path.description: Your working tree (cwd / worktree); pass WITH project.

symbolId.description: Target symbol id (e.g. Foo.bar). Provide exactly one of 'symbolId' / 'relativePath'.

relativePath.description: Target FILE, repo-relative (e.g. src/core/app.ts) — file scope: returns the files importing it. Provide exactly one of 'symbolId' / 'relativePath'.

limit.description: Max caller edges / importer files (default 50; depth>1 tree rows: 40)

offset.description: Rows to skip, in the answer's stable order.

depth.description: symbolId only: hops to walk, 1–3 (default 1). Above 1 → BFS tree.

includeAmbiguous.description: Also attach ambiguousCallers: member-matched dispatch sites that MAY reach target, not edges. Default false.
